en:
## New Features

- Named narrators and multi-party chat groups: assign a globally unique @handle to a standalone narrator, then mention it with @handle from any session to form a chat group; mentioned members gain full control (approve agent permissions, interrupt the session), and urgent messages can trigger a soft-stop
- Migrated the narrator message list to a chunked virtualization layer with realtime sync, scroll-to-message jumping, and multi-select, greatly improving stability for very long histories and cross-narrator collaboration
- New "Stop" hook event fired once at the end of each response turn for the main narrator (covering the done / error / aborted / max-turns paths), executed non-blocking so hook failures never affect narrator state
- Plan mode "allow inline plan" toggle (on by default); when turned off, ExitPlanMode only accepts file-based plans
- runBashFirst now supports queuing, so Bash commands can be queued while the narrator is running instead of being rejected
- Context compaction can now be cancelled, aborting an in-progress compact and silently rolling back without marking it as an error
- Recent tabs now support chat-group entries and restoring a cleared list

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed realtime sync of compact markers (insert/delete and compacting→compacted transitions) in the virtualized message list, along with chunk scroll targeting
- Fixed turns whose only new content is a system message (e.g. goal continuation) producing empty conversation input and erroring out on some proxies
- Built-in gateway web search now fails fast when all credentials are disabled instead of waiting for a 60s timeout
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 命名叙述者与多方聊天组：可为独立叙述者分配全局唯一 @handle，在任意会话中用 @handle 提及并组建多方聊天组；被提及的命名成员获得完全控制（代理审批、中断会话），紧急消息可触发软停止
- 叙述者消息列表切换到 chunk 虚拟化数据层，补齐实时同步、滚动定位与多选能力，大幅提升超长历史的浏览与跨叙述者协作稳定性
- 新增「Stop」钩子事件：主叙述者每个响应轮次结束（涵盖完成 / 出错 / 中断 / 到达轮次上限）时触发一次，非阻塞执行，钩子失败不影响叙述者状态
- Plan 模式新增「允许内联计划」开关（默认开启），关闭后 ExitPlanMode 仅支持文件形式的计划
- runBashFirst 支持排队执行：叙述者运行中也可排队 Bash 命令，不再直接拒绝
- 上下文压缩（compact）支持取消：可中断进行中的压缩并静默回滚，不标记为错误
- 最近标签页支持聊天组类型与「恢复清空」

## 修复

- 修复虚拟化消息列表中 compact 标记的插入/删除与状态流转（compacting→compacted）实时同步问题，以及 chunk 跳转定位
- 修复仅含系统消息的轮次（如目标延续）对话输入为空、在部分代理上报错的问题
- 内置网关联网搜索在凭证全部禁用时快速失败，不再等待 60 秒超时
